title: Crispy Black Bean Tacos
description: Pan-crisped tortillas stuffed with spiced black beans and melty cheese.

items: 2 (15 oz) cans black beans, drained and rinsed
Shredded cabbage, avocado and lime wedges, to serve
Mash the beans roughly with the cumin, chili powder, salt and salsa in a bowl.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave under a damp towel for 30 seconds so they bend without cracking.
Spread a spoonful of beans over half of each tortilla, top with cheese and fold.
Heat a thin layer of oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Fry the tacos in batches for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts.
Drain on paper towels and stuff with cabbage and avocado. Serve with lime.

notes: Pinto beans or refried beans swap in easily.
